description.en: Zenless Zone Zero H.D.D + Fairy unified theme with 3 switchable presets (Amber Black-Gold, Street HUD, Light Archive), 6-panel mix-and-match matrix, Periodic Table model selector, Overdrive effort slider, 12 interaction juice FX, usage telemetry dashboard, and cross-platform animated Fairy eye.
description.zh-CN: 绝区零 H.D.D + Fairy 全端视觉扩展：内置黑金重工、新艾利都街头 HUD、绳网高反差浅色三套自动明暗联动预设，支持 6 大面板独立混搭、元素周期表模型选择器、超频胶囊滑轨、12 项机械交互动效、算力用量终端与跨端 Fairy 动态眼徽。

details.en:
## Highlights in v2.2.0

- **Three Switchable ZZZ Presets with Auto Light/Dark Linkage**: Switch cleanly between **H.D.D Amber Terminal** (Black-Gold dark), **New Eridu Street HUD** (Acid-Lime dark), and **Random Play Archive** (high-contrast light workspace with obsidian code blocks & dark terminal), or mix and match across 6 independent panel regions (`shell`, `chat`, `composer`, `rightbar`, `settings`, `usage`).
- **Periodic Table Model Selector & Overdrive Capsule Slider**: Antigravity 2x2 element core cards (`01 H`, `06 C`, `10 Ne`, `18 Ar`) paired with a Codex-style full-width capsule thinking effort slider featuring a pure white circular thumb, smooth Overdrive stardust flow, and zero-flicker stay-open switching.
- **12-Point ZZZ Interaction Juice & Live Chat Fairy Eye**: Tactile mechanical keycap press, 45-deg metallic sheen, focus hazard march, Telegram-style consecutive assistant grouping, and viewport-only animated Fairy eye badges (auto-paused when hidden, toggleable).
- **Welcome Usage Telemetry & 26-Week Heatmap**: Collapsible single-line capsule and full KPI / Model / Harness / Quota dashboard reading native CodexHost statistics.
- **Cross-Platform Fairy Eye Widget & Control Console (`widget` + `page`)**: Silent H.D.D boot animation, draggable Fairy eye across Desktop & Web (auto-disabled on phones), and a zero-emoji 36-icon geometric SVG control page.
- **Full CodexHost v0.28.1 Compatibility & Mobile 390px Polish**: Native transcript virtualization compatibility, obsidian code fold bar, unified Harness menu skin, watching indicators, remote topology & pairing cards, and elastic mobile composer.
- **Pure Frontend & Zero Audio**: No backend subprocess, no audio, no prompt mutation; disabling cleanly restores all styles and DOM.
details.zh-CN:
## v2.2.0 核心特性

- **三套绝区零风格预设 · 自动明暗联动**：一键切换 **方案 A · H.D.D 黑金重工**、**方案 B · 新艾利都街头 HUD** 与 **方案 C · 绳网高反差白卡（自动切整页浅色，同时保留护眼黑曜石代码块与暗色终端）**；并支持 **6 大面板区域**（左侧栏与顶栏、对话流与工具卡、输入舱与问答审批、右侧工作台、设置与插件中心、新会话算力用量面板）独立启用与跨预设混搭。
- **Antigravity 元素周期表模型选择器 & 超频胶囊滑轨**：独创 2x2 元素核心矩阵（`01 H` / `06 C` / `10 Ne` / `18 Ar`）与 Codex 风格饱满胶囊思考档位滑轨，纯白圆形滑块配合超频态胶囊内单向流光微粒，切换档位面板原地保持不闪烁。
- **12 项绝区零交互动效（Juice）与气泡动态眼徽**：覆盖机械键帽按压、45 度金属扫光、输入舱警戒条推进与悬停锁定反馈；连续助手回复自动采用 Telegram 风格头像归组，仅在视口内组尾气泡按需挂载轻量动态 Fairy 眼徽（隐藏窗口自动暂停，支持一键开关）。
- **新会话算力用量终端**：欢迎页顶部集成可折叠算力胶囊条与展开态统计看板（KPI、26 周热力图、模型/Harness 拆解与模型配额），直接读取 CodexHost 原生统计。
- **跨端悬浮眼徽与全零 Emoji 控制中心（`widget` + `page`）**：Desktop 与 Web 主窗口共享静音 H.D.D 开机动画与可拖动 Fairy 眼徽（手机端自动停用），全仓 36 枚工业几何单线 SVG 图标零 Emoji 覆盖。
- **完整适配 CodexHost v0.28.1 与 390px 移动端**：无缝兼容原生对话虚拟滚动、长代码块黑曜石折叠条、统一 Harness 选择器、监听中标识、远程主机拓扑与配对面板，以及手机端抽屉侧栏与弹性底栏。
- **纯前端 · 零后端 · 无音频**：未声明 `backend`，不启动 Node 子进程、不播放音频、不修改提示词；停用即完整回收全部样式与 DOM 标记。
